prompts.name: zh-jingdezhen-porcelain-v2
prompts.prompt:
Edit the supplied icon into a MUCH SIMPLER tiny game-board icon. The supplied image is the edit target and subject reference, not a request to keep its detail. Preserve its subject and warm friendly pastel mood, but redraw it with the visual simplicity of a cute flat children's board-game pictogram. Aim for about 80 percent less detail. Large smooth softly rounded silhouettes, 3–4 solid pastel colors, matte cream highlights, no outlines or only extremely soft edges. NO watercolor granulation, paper texture, brush speckles, mottling, fine shading, reflections, intricate patterns, small structural details, realistic rendering, or decorative extra elements. Mostly flat fills, at most ONE large simple shadow shape on the entire icon. Readability at 32px is the top priority. Replace ALL elaborate flowers, leaves and scrollwork with ONE cobalt blue three-petal flower symbol centered on its belly. The entire flower is just three chunky rounded petals, no veins, no tendrils, no stems or extra decorations. Flat warm ivory and dusty cobalt blue, one very pale blue side shadow only. No visible interior rings or porcelain reflections.
